title: ZnO supplied phonon modes with natural-isotope coherent neutron lengths

probe.isotopeConvention: natural isotopic composition, real bound coherent scattering lengths

source.title: NIST Center for Neutron Research: Neutron Scattering Lengths and Cross Sections
source.columnsUsed: Element rows Zn and O, bound coherent scattering length (fm)

conditionsToDeclare: These are computed phonon modes and literature scattering lengths, not a measured ZnO spectrum.
The supplied four q points are not a complete thermal integration mesh.
Debye-Waller omission must remain an explicit approximation; zero temperature does not eliminate zero-point displacement.
A thermal displacement tensor must be supplied with its actual structure, atom order, units and temperature before it is used.
No X-ray form factors, isotope disorder, incoherent background, magnetic scattering or sample absorption correction is supplied.
